llm.summary: This Chinese K12 classroom coaching skill is coherent, disclosed, and limits its sensitive data use to classroom interaction support and teacher-confirmed records.

dimensions.detail: The package is intentionally scoped to Mainland China Chinese K12 teaching. Shared platform guidance documents that regional scope and requires localization of curriculum, consent rules, and emergency help channels before use elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown and JSON files only; file permissions are non-executable, metadata is empty, and the supplied static scan reported no T01-T09 findings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Trigger phrases are broad, but the artifact includes adjacent-request routing and explicit boundaries for lesson planning, exam design, analytics, homework, point-naming students, and student-facing use. I did not find hidden prompt overrides, tool hijacking, exfiltration instructions, or unrelated authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on platform memory and timing capabilities, but degrades when unavailable, provides privacy controls, and writes only interactionLogs as teacher-confirmed entries. It also instructs that classroom logs avoid student names and use aggregate or question-level observations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is classroom interaction coaching: adapting questions, grouping, timing, cold-call alternatives, and post-class reflection. Reading lesson goals, student tiers, and weakness summaries is purpose-aligned for differentiated classroom guidance, and the skill explicitly says it does not write lesson plans, create assessments, or perform learning analytics.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for the intended Chinese K12 teacher workflow. Confirm the platform enforces the stated read/write boundaries, teacher confirmation for interactionLogs, and consent controls for student tier/weakness data; localize curriculum assumptions and crisis contacts before using it outside Mainland China.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad classroom phrases are expected for an interaction coach, and the skill adds a non-goal table routing lesson plans, exercises, analytics, and homework to other skills, so this is a minor activation-quality note rather than a security concern.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only content is consistent with the documented Mainland China Chinese K12 deployment scope in shared/platform-conventions.md and crisis guidance; deployments outside that scope should localize rather than treat this as hidden behavior.
[SDI-1] expected: lessonPlans access is disclosed as read-only context for objectives, question chains, and timing; the SKILL.md states lessonPlans are not written by this skill and interactionLogs are its only write target.
[SDI-1] expected: studentTiers and weaknessRank are sensitive educational profiling data, but their use is directly tied to differentiated grouping and question focus, with aliases, no real names/contact data in the schema, and no write authority to those fields.
